title: No R5 regression — streaming preserved, verify + tool path intact (arm A = fix)
sub: the copy path only engages for host-backed fds; sockets, anon pipes, char devices still stream
body: ++ cat 1 MiB | sha256sum (anon pipe)  match, streamed
++ /dev/zero char device | head -c 8   8 bytes, shared directly
++ segmented writer | cat             'a b' in order
++ < 3 GiB sparse file wc -c          3221225472 exact, peak RSS ~212 MiB (no full buffering)
== qwen sandbox --verify  (both arms x 4 policies)   8/8 runs, 'Confinement verified (4 checks)' each
== model tool path (scripted run_shell_command, prompt piped on CLI stdin)
++ A fix + policy      write outside ws -> EROFS   stdin=/dev/null bytes=0   pids=5 (private PID ns)
== A no policy         write outside ws -> WRITTEN  stdin=/dev/null           pids=255 (host)
++ B parent + policy   write outside ws -> EROFS   stdin=/dev/null bytes=0   pids=5   (R6-1 never reached the model path)
